entities.summary: Byzantine, a notable figure in the history of Malta, associated with Arab, Norman, and Medieval Malta (395–1091). Preceded by Byzantine and Arab Malta. Their legacy influenced Arab conquest of Malta — origins of the Maltese language's Semitic roots and Norman and Medieval Feudal Rule.
